answer: An operator running 60 keys as a result forfeits for 60 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the ferrous salt is published after the shale checkpoint, the relic audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 170 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
